questions.stem: A triangle has sides $a = 7\text{ cm}$, $b = 9\text{ cm}$, and the included angle $C = 50°$. Which method should you use to find side $c$?
questions.explanation: You know two sides and the included angle (SAS), so you should use the cosine rule: $c^2 = a^2 + b^2 - 2ab\cos C$.

questions.stem: Two ships leave a port. Ship A sails $10\text{ km}$ on a bearing of $060°$ and Ship B sails $15\text{ km}$ on a bearing of $120°$. What is the angle at the port between the two ships' paths?
questions.explanation: The angle between the two bearings is $120° - 60° = 60°$.
